prompt.project_info: Photorealistic casual bedroom portrait in soft morning window light with authentic everyday details.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with fair-to-light-olive skin, subtle pores and freckles, long natural wavy brown hair, soft everyday makeup, realistic proportions and natural skin texture, wearing a fitted white cropped tank top, high-waisted light denim shorts and barefoot.
prompt.composition_elements: Casual portrait leaning against a bedroom doorframe, one hand in hair and the other resting on the thigh, weight shifted naturally to one leg. Use a gentle relaxed S-curve without body emphasis. Include wooden floor, sheer curtains, unmade bed, phone on nightstand and subtle natural clutter.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused side window light with gentle volumetric rays, balanced realistic shadows and cinematic everyday morning atmosphere without studio flash.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm lens at f/1.8, shallow creamy background bokeh, hyper-photorealistic 8K raw-photo feel, natural color grading and realistic skin/fabric detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic casual bedroom portrait in soft morning window light of one original approved adult woman with fair-to-light-olive skin, subtle pores and freckles, long natural wavy brown hair, soft everyday makeup and realistic natural proportions. She wears a fitted white cropped tank top, high-waisted light denim shorts and is barefoot. Lean her casually against a bedroom doorframe with one hand in her hair and the other resting on her thigh, weight shifted naturally to one leg with a relaxed everyday posture. Include soft sheer curtains, wooden floor, an unmade bed in the background, a phone on the nightstand and subtle natural clutter. Use soft diffused side window light with gentle volumetric rays, balanced realistic shadows, a Canon EOS R5 with 85mm lens at f/1.8, creamy shallow background bokeh, hyper-photorealistic 8K raw-photo feel, natural color grading and realistic skin and fabric detail.
